chains.conclusion: The Economy chain shows one RISING and two DROPPING signals. The T10Y2Y yield spread dropped to 0.30 from a 0.42 average, a 29% compression suggesting the curve is flattening further, which historically precedes slower growth or recessionary pressure. Job posting volume is modestly below average. Cardboard box production data is silent. The layoff and yield signals are directionally consistent with macro softening but do not yet converge to a flaggable threshold.
